title: QCA988x Xtensa Target Firmware Rate-Control (rc_update_ht, rc_sib_update, EVM/PER Step-Down Hysteresis) Dissection
attribution: QCA firmware + proprietary airMAX/LTU module + ath10k

target_rate_control_globals.role: Maximum Packet Error Rate (PER %) threshold before the QCA988x target rate-control state machine steps down to the next lower MCS index. Read/written by HT_COMM SET_REG (0x009b9234 @ 0x009b930f and 0x009b9432) and by ROM rc_update_ht via vtable 0x0040da20.
Instantaneous PER penalty added to a peer's moving-average PER estimate whenever a PPDU exhausts its hardware retry series (XRETRY). Mutated by HT_COMM SET_REG (@ 0x009b9315 / 0x009b9435).
Consecutive no-ACK PPDU burst threshold that triggers immediate emergency MCS step-down before the normal EWMA PER window expires. Mutated by HT_COMM SET_REG (@ 0x009b9285 / 0x009b942f).
Rate-control upward-MCS probe period initialized to 0x1388 (5000) in WMI_PEER_ASSOC_CMDID (@ 0x0098a018) and tunable via HT_COMM SET_REG (@ 0x009b9302).
Minimum packet count between upward MCS probes, initialized to 32 in WMI_PEER_ASSOC_CMDID (@ 0x0098a024).
Boolean enable flag for rate-control probing, initialized to 1 in WMI_PEER_ASSOC_CMDID (@ 0x0098a026).
Target software-retry limit enforced by ubnt_poll TX completion / scheduling (@ 0x009b5b06) and printed at 0x009b9556 ('g_dbg_vht_illegal_rate_err_cnt: %d, g_dbg_max_sw_retry: %d').
Counter incremented when VHT rate selection encounters an invalid NSS/MCS/BW combination.

WMI_PEER_SET_PARAM_CMDID_0x901f.role: Updates per-peer parameters (MIMO PS, AMPDU factor/density, SGI mask, LDPC, STBC, NSS, non-agg/agg SW & HW retry thresholds 17/18/29/30) via wal_peer_set_param (0x0098c0c0).

wmi_vdev_set_param_fixed_rate_case_0x1a.role: Handles WMI_VDEV_PARAM_FIXED_RATE (0x1a): stores fixed rate into vdev+0x4c, iterates over associated peers (vdev+0x28 list), calls *(0x0040da20 + 0x08) (rc_sib_update) on each peer's rate-control context, and invokes ubnt_poll Slot 5 (0x009afd14 -> 0x009ad36c) to sync TDMA rate state.

wmi_peer_assoc_rc_init.role: WMI_PEER_ASSOC_CMDID (0x901e) handler: parses peer ni_flags, phymode, nss, mpdudensity, max_mpdu, ht_caps, vht_caps, vht_mcs_set, and initializes RC probe globals (*0x0040d4e0 = 5000, *0x0040d4e4 = 32, *0x0040d4e8 = 1).

ubnt_poll_ht_comm_set_reg_rc_knobs.role: Target handler for HT_COMM opcode 1 (SET_REG) / opcode 2 (GET_REG): reads/writes g_default_no_ack_wifi_thr (0x0040da14), g_rc_probe_period (0x0040d4e0), g_rc_rate_max_per_thr (0x0040da7c), and g_default_xretry_per_penalty (0x0040da78).

ubnt_poll_target_rate_override_0x009b444.role: Target ubnt_poll rate-series builder: translates airMAX rate index into QCA988x hardware rate-code via vtable 0x0040de28 (+0x04 / +0x0c) and populates retry series via vtable 0x0040d898.

ubnt_poll_ht_comm_rate_set_override_0x00.role: Target handler for HT_COMM opcode 10 (0x0a, RATE_OVERRIDE): unpacks up to 4 custom rate/retry series entries from host ubnt_poll_host_set_rate_override and commits them to the peer TX context via 0x009b51c4 and 0x009b47d0.

mcs_cliff_root_cause_and_openwrt_mitigat.stock_airos8_mcs_cliff_mechanism: CONFIRMED: In stock airOS 8, rate adaptation is split across two competing loops: (1) QCA988x target PER rate control governed by g_rc_rate_max_per_thr (0x0040da7c), g_default_xretry_per_penalty (0x0040da78), and g_default_no_ack_wifi_thr (0x0040da14), and (2) host ubnt_poll_host.ko (ubnt_poll_host_set_rate_override @ 0x0b2d4, ubnt_poll_host_set_swr_limit @ 0x0b404, ubnt_poll_host_set_reg @ 0x07f0c), which consumes target EVM pilot measurements (HT_COMM opcode 40 @ 0x009b1132) and pushes restricted 4-series rate tables via HT_COMM opcode 10 (0x009b6afc) while raising XRETRY PER penalties via HT_COMM opcode 1 (0x009b9234). Under a transient 5 GHz interference burst, XRETRY penalties + EVM step-down clamp the allowed MCS table from 8x (256-QAM) down to 2x/4x (QPSK/16-QAM) and hold it down across multiple 5000 ms probe periods (g_rc_probe_period = 0x1388).
mcs_cliff_root_cause_and_openwrt_mitigat.openwrt_24_10_4_ath10k_mitigation: CONFIRMED: In OpenWrt 24.10.4 with ath10k, ubnt_poll_host.ko is absent and HT_COMM opcodes 1/10/40 never overwrite the peer rate table or inflate g_default_xretry_per_penalty. Furthermore, ath10k exposes deterministic WMI_VDEV_SET_PARAM_CMDID (0x901a) controls directly to the host: VHT80_RATEMASK (0x24 @ 0x0099bcc7), VHT_SGIMASK (0x23 @ 0x0099bcd4), FIXED_RATE (0x1a @ 0x0099bd84 -> rc_sib_update), SGI (0x1e @ 0x0099bd1a), LDPC (0x2a @ 0x0099bc47), and RTS_THRESHOLD (0x01 @ 0x0099bc02), allowing floor-bounded VHT MCS masks (e.g. permitting MCS 4..9 while excluding QPSK/BPSK cliff states on high-SNR PtP links) and RTS/CTS hidden-node protection so transient collisions do not trigger unprotected A-MPDU XRETRY cascades.

key_findings.claim: Exact Xtensa RAM addresses of the QCA988x target rate-control hysteresis globals in WA.v8.7.25 PtP: g_rc_rate_max_per_thr = 0x0040da7c, g_default_xretry_per_penalty = 0x0040da78, g_default_no_ack_wifi_thr = 0x0040da14, g_rc_probe_period = 0x0040d4e0 (init 5000), g_dbg_max_sw_retry = 0x0040d364, and g_dbg_vht_illegal_rate_err_cnt = 0x00410b58.

WMI_VDEV_SET_PARAM_CMDID (0x901a @ 0x0099bb50, 48-slot jump table @ 0x0099bb72 PtP / 0x0099bf0a AP / 0x0099bf36 STA) dispatches 28 active parameters including RTS_THRESHOLD (0x01), SLOT_TIME (0x0f), FORCE_RTS_CTS (0x13), CHWIDTH (0x19), FIXED_RATE (0x1a -> loops over peers calling rc_sib_update at *(0x0040da20+8) and ubnt_poll Slot 5 0x009afd14), SGI (0x1e), VHT_SGIMASK (0x23), VHT80_RATEMASK (0x24), LDPC (0x2a), TX_STBC (0x2b), and NSS (0x2e..0x2f).

wal_peer_set_param (0x0098c0c0, 32-slot jump table @ 0x0098c0eb) handles 32 per-peer parameters including NON_AGG_SW_RETRY_TH (17), AGG_SW_RETRY_TH (18), DEFAULT_RATE_INDEX (19), SGI_MASK (20), LDPC_ENABLE (21), STBC_ENABLE (22), NSS (23), CHAN_WIDTH (24), NON_AGG_HW_RETRY_TH (29), AGG_HW_RETRY_TH (30), and MAX_AGGR_SIZE (31).
